title: Best Meals After a Busy Shift
subtitle: When the job was hard and the crew needs hot food
description: Best meals after a busy shift: comfort trays, chili, pasta bakes, and proteins that hold while people decompress.
intro: After a busy shift, dinner is not nutrition — it is reset. The best meals after a hard job are familiar, hot, and plentiful. This is not the night for experimental flavors or small portions.

sections.heading: Food that matches the mood
paragraphs: Mac, parm, chili, pulled pork, potato bars. Soft + salty + optional heat wins over 'light and elegant.'

sections.heading: Timing dinner after a hard job
paragraphs: Start comfort food early if the board hints busy. Let people eat in shifts without commentary — the meal is for recovery, not performance reviews.

practicalAdvice: Start comfort food early if the board hints busy — do not wait until 21:00.
Let people eat in shifts without commentary about 'late eaters.'
Keep cleanup assigned — exhaustion plus dishes causes fights.

mealRecommendations.title: Baked Mac and Cheese
mealRecommendations.blurb: Cheese and carbs — the usual reset.

faqs.question: Where do these recipes come from?
faqs.answer: Each link goes to a full recipe on Firehall Meals — crew-sized portions, station timing, and steps written for a shared kitchen. Not home-blog scaling.

faqs.question: What if crew size or time changes tonight?
faqs.answer: Use Find a Meal with your headcount and minutes available. It pulls from the same hall-tested dinners these guides recommend.
